family: NEMA 17 external trapezoidal lead-screw stepper 17E19S1684MB4-300RS (non-captive nut on an integral Tr8x8 screw)
source_level: vendor documents transcribed by the collector from an image-only drawing; vendor STEP measured here
title: 17E19S1684MB4-300RS product page and drawing (files.omc-stepperonline.com/17E19S1684MB4-300RS.pdf)
provenance_note: the PDF has no text layer: every 'drawing' value below was read from its pixels by the collecting agent (properties file) and could not be machine-checked here. 'step' values were measured in the vendor's STEP with mechloop's CAD kernel on 2026-11-15

thread_depth_min_mm.source: drawing (transcribed); step: 2.5 mm tap-drill holes 4.5 deep

mass_kg.note: the PDF says 0.35 kg, the product page 454 g; neither was weighed. The HEAVIER is used for mass, moving-mass and weight checks (conservative); the lighter is kept in the part's ratings

axial_load_rating_n.status: NOT STATED by the maker on the product page or the drawing: no thrust rating, no thrust curve, no bearing axial-load limit

secondary_claim.what: 'Minimal Thrust (N) @300pps' on a reseller page for the same model number (osmtec.com)
secondary_claim.not: a permissible axial load or a bearing rating; a speed-specific output-thrust claim. Not used

efficiency.status: not stated; the catalogue uses 0.5 as for its other 8 mm-lead trapezoidal screw (typical, unverified)

connector.side: one side face, at the rear
connector.note: two lead stubs go 2 mm further

nut.mount_holes: 3 x 3.56 dia on a 19.05 mm circle
nut.note: an inch-dimensioned flanged nut is drawn on the screw in the STEP; the transcription says only that nut dimensions are on the drawing. Material and whether it is anti-backlash: not stated

compared_with_catalogue.leadscrew_t8: the catalogue's separate T8 screw is used by the printers with lead 2 mm (T8x2) behind a 5x8 coupler; this part is lead 8 mm and has no coupler: 4 times the travel per step (0.04 mm against 0.01 mm) and a quarter of the force per unit torque. They are distinct SKUs
compared_with_catalogue.nema17(48): same 42.3 x 48 frame and hole pattern as the 17HS19-2004S1; 0.44 N.m against 0.59

licence: not stated on the product page
